# Marco D'Antonio — Portfolio & personAI

> One-page portfolio and AI assistant for Marco D'Antonio, full-stack developer & AI engineer.
> Built with Next.js 16, Tailwind v4, Three.js, Lenis, Cloudflare Workers AI.
> Deployed on Cloudflare Workers via OpenNext.

## Architecture

Two locale routes: `/` (Italian) and `/en` (English). All content is anchor-navigated:
`#about` → `#education` → `#skills` → `#projects` → `#experience` → `#contact`

The only dynamic route is `/api/personai` — a RAG-based chat endpoint powered by Cloudflare Workers AI (`llama-3.1-8b-instruct`).

## Key conventions

- One-page layout: all sections in `app/(it)/page.tsx` and `app/(en)/en/page.tsx` as SpotlightSection + Container
- All UI text in `content/i18n.ts` (bilingual IT/EN dictionary)
- `/en` is the English locale route; toggles should navigate the URL, not only state
- Scroll-linked animations subscribe to `lib/scroll-signal` (one shared rAF listener)
- Reuse `components/system/*` before writing custom layout wrappers
- Reuse `components/ui/*` before styling raw markup
- Never reintroduce `.surface-card`, `.section-copy`, `.eyebrow` legacy helpers
- Run `npm run lint && npm run build` before considering work complete
